verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents a Python library, a Cloud SDK/API (client.runs.create, an OpenAPI v4 spec), and an official MCP server, but nothing about an official command-line interface. SDKs, APIs and MCP servers are adjacent developer surfaces, not a CLI. A CLI is a fair axis for a browser-automation product, so the absence of evidence makes this none, not na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
